research_notes: Follow up exact 2UE dates and leave to narrow its full-time range; resolve overseas employment versus freelance contracts, Telecom hours and business intensity/breaks. Verify LBC historical control and legal transitions between Media Skills and Templeman Consulting.

2026-09-29 avenues: APH biography and first-speech indexed text (direct 403), personal website, Rotary speaker biography, 2023 Hansard reproduction, PM's 1990 ownership statement, parliamentary Telstra history, FPNSW 2009/2010/2011/2013 reports and UCF 2012 professional profile. Searches for early radio work and full-time evidence found the first-speech statement; later roles remain unsupported for full-time duration.

Private scalar is null despite countable 2UE range: schema has no numeric min/max fields, so range is explicitly documented in existing notes without changing shared schema or inventing dates. 1985–1988 is not exactly three years. No summation of London jobs or post-return freelance work with Telecom/training. 2023 speech reports work through pregnancy and early parenthood, not hours or a precisely dated leave interval.

Further leads: Sexual Health Australia board and school P&C presidencies need primary dates/role confirmation; not paid employment by assumption. Qualifications and Rotary exchange are study. Family work pay unknown, union membership not union employment. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; blocked record still needs systematic follow-up.

2026-10-01 follow-up materially resolves Family Planning NSW resignation27November2012, overlooked in the previously cited2012–13 report. Earlier note that final date was unverified is superseded. No extra employment duration arises from governance dates.

Rechecked2023 paid-parental-leave Hansard, Rotary career biography, FPNSW2013 directors report/biography and ABR historical company record. The two later business names cannot safely be treated as one legal entity solely from a narrative career biography. Secondary2016 interests transcription separately lists spouse interests in Media Skills and Templeman Consulting, a lead for original declarations rather than personal employment evidence. Searches for Sexual Health Australia and P&C dates produced repeated unsourced biographies, not new primary confirmation. Overseas contracts, LBC historical ownership, Telecom hours/maternity transition, company-specific work boundaries and campaign leave remain unresolved. No new scalar years or inferred full-time status.

Second follow-up2October2026 materially refines2UE start to January1985 from first-speech public index. No end-month or leave evidence found. Historical LBC searches identify Crown Communications, but primary shareholding/control documentation remains outstanding; government_control_at_time not upgraded from secondary name alone. Trade-press March1991 report PDF returned403; IRDP history returned non-retryable safe-open error; Guardian open DisabledError; indexed ownership evidence only. Search hits for part-time work were constituents quoted in later speeches, not Templeman employment. Telecom hours, maternity transition, business intensity and school/sexual-health governance dates remain unresolved. Next seek original Crown annual reports1990–91 (library catalogue lead), personally dated2UE departure and Telecom contract/leave records. No totals added.

Third follow-up3October2026: a2025 Saturday Paper interview supplies a direct first-person description of taking a Telecom media-relations job in1990 and its customer-complaint/spokesperson duties. This strengthens active-employment evidence but does not establish full-time hours, exact appointment/cessation, leave or the new-baby transition. Repeated 2UE, LBC and Media Skills searches otherwise returned the official year chronology, derivative biographies or already recorded rounded descriptions; no further boundary was adopted.
